# CANDIDATE: RIB_STEEP_VWAP_PULLBACK_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When the EMA ribbon is steeply aligned upward and price retraces to VWAP with weak RSI, the uptrend is likely to resume. This captures a short‑term pullback within a strong intraday uptrend, allowing entry with favorable risk‑reward.

## Mechanism

Entry on 5‑min bar when EMA9 > EMA20 > EMA50 AND price crosses above VWAP within the same bar AND RSI(14) < 45 AND bar close > VWAP. Initial stop at low of the pullback bar, TP1 at 1.5R, runner trailed 12% off high‑water‑mark. Regime filters: VIX < 20, time after 09:45 EST, and 15‑min market structure showing higher highs/higher lows.
